scriptComments: @objClone - one row per bullet sprite clonepointer to row in @obj
@bul - bullet initialiseronly used to 'spawn' new bullets.
@obj - Linked list of objects objects0 - next1 - grid id2 - @objClone row #3 - type4 - health5 - x6 - y7 - sx8 - sy9 - dir
@players0 - Player Name (or "")1 - Tank Type2 - x3 - y4 - sx5 - sy6 - dir
Request clone to spawn for all objects in grid cell!
@players0 - Player Name (or "")1 - Tank Type2 - x3 - y4 - sx5 - sy6 - dir7 - grid id8 - obj id9 - last cloud10 - cloud change time
Can't be hit by own bullets
Cloud failure requires reload of project to fix
